# Jim Pattison Lexus - Northshore

> Jim Pattison Lexus - Northshore is a  dealership in North Vancouver. This mirror provides AI-readable access to current inventory and dealership information, kept in sync with the dealership's own website.

## Inventory
- [Used vehicles](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/jim-pattison-lexus-northshore-mirror/used/): 42 vehicles, updated regularly
- [Inventory feed](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/jim-pattison-lexus-northshore-mirror/inventory.json): structured JSON, all vehicles with VIN, price, mileage and availability
